**Finding: missing (medium) — no transition assistance or data-return right on exit.**

- **What the document has:** Section 11.3 preserves valuable run-off rights for us (continued Customer access under Section 2, surviving Commerce One support and maintenance while we keep paying, and the Section 12 source code escrow). But the only exit mechanic touching data is a mutual "return **or** destroy any Confidential Information" — destruction at the holder's option, with no format, no deadline and no certification.
- **Why it fails the fallback:** There is no transition-assistance right at all, and no export obligation within any timeframe. Since Commerce One hosts the MarketSite.net Service that our Customers transact through, our and our Customers' data can sit on its systems with no contractual route back to us.
- **Fix (validated, preferred position):** New Section 11.4 inserted after 11.3 — up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Corio/Customer data in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days of request, then deletion plus written certification, carved back for Commerce One's surviving obligations and legal retention so it does not cut across the 11.3 run-off. Fallback of 90 days' assistance offered in the comment.
